query: We already have New_Request and Approval_Logs live with real data. Add the precheck list, and also build the screens and the approval flow while you're at it.
notes: Two tests in one: delta-only provisioning against a live site, and negative routing for the two out-of-scope asks.
expected_behavior: Asks which lists already exist, or uses the two named, and generates ONLY the delta
Does not emit a create-script for a list that already holds data
Warns that adding an index to a list already past the list-view threshold can fail
Routes the screens to generating-powerapps-yaml by name
Routes the flow to building-powerautomate-flows by name
Still validates the lists section before generating
Confirms the new list carries the text join key and the audit pair
fail_if: Emits a create-list command for New_Request or Approval_Logs
Generates pa.yaml or a flow package
Fails to name the sibling skills
Drops the join key from the new list
